title: eludite.debug stop summary
description: The compact answer of eludite.debug.snapshot, wait and pause and of start, attach, restart, continue, step_over, step_into, step_out, run_to_cursor, run_until and set_next_statement (and of trace's `stopped_by: stopped`; proposal 0001 rule 2): why and where the debuggee stopped, the top frames, the frame's locals and the watches within the budget parameters, the program's output since a cursor, the adapter's capabilities and who drives. Breakpoints, exception settings and threads are in eludite.debug.state.

session.description: The session this summary describes (brief 0028): its id, as in eludite.debug.sessions. Absent before any session started.

mode.description: `design`: no session. `building`: F5 or Ctrl+F5 is building the startup project first (the setting build.beforeRun); the launch follows when the build succeeds, and the session goes back to `design` with `message` saying why when it fails or is canceled. `launching`: the adapter and the debuggee are starting. `running`: the debuggee runs (also while a step is in flight). `break`: stopped; the call stack, locals and watches are filled. `stopping`: the session is ending. `running_without_debugging`: started with Ctrl+F5.

generation.description: The session generation: it grows with every start. Events and answers of an older session are dropped.

stop.description: Grows every time the debuggee breaks. Quote it as `stop` in a command to have the command refused if the debuggee moved on since (another driver stepped).

stopped.description: In break mode: why and where it stopped.

location.description: The statement it stopped at (the top frame of `thread`).

path.description: Absent for a frame without source (external code).

end_column.description: The statement's end column, when known.

function.description: The method, as the Call Stack window shows it.

exception.description: When the reason is `exception`: what was thrown (eludite.debug.exception_info has the details).

type.description: The exception type, when the adapter says.

breakpoint.description: When the reason is `breakpoint`: the breakpoint it stopped at.

hits.description: Times it was reached in this session.

driver.description: Who resumed the debuggee before this stop: `user` or `agent:<name>`.

frames.description: The top `max_frames` frames of the thread that stopped (or of `thread`), as eludite.debug.stack lists them; page further with eludite.debug.stack.

index.description: The frame's index in its thread's stack (0 is the top).

name.description: The method, as the Call Stack window shows it.

path.description: The source file, when the frame has one.

end_line.description: The statement's end, when the adapter gives it.

external.description: True for a frame without source (Visual Studio's [External Code]); absent otherwise.

total.description: How many frames the stack has.

locals.description: The frame's variables, expanded to `depth` within `max_variables` rows, each row as eludite.debug.variables lists it; page further with eludite.debug.variables (`thread`, `frame`, `start: next`).

frame.description: The frame's index (0 is the top).

total.description: How many top-level variables the frame has.

truncated.description: Some rows or members were left out by the budget.

next.description: When top-level rows were left out: the `start` of the next page.

watches.description: The Watch window's expressions with the values it shows, which are the selected frame's: listed when the summary is of that frame (evaluating them in another frame would run code).

reference.description: Non-zero when the value has members.

error.description: Why it could not be evaluated.

output.description: The program's output lines (source `program` of eludite.debug.output) from `output_since`, or the last `max_output_lines` lines.

seq.description: The line's sequence number in this session and source.

stream.description: Where the line came from, when known.

next.description: The cursor to pass as `output_since` (or eludite.debug.output's `since`) next time.

dropped.description: Lines after `output_since` the ring overwrote before they were read.

total.description: How many lines the program has written in this session.

exit_code.description: After the session ended: the program's exit code, when known.

message.description: After the session ended, or when a command failed: why.

agent_driving.description: The last command that resumed, paused or started the debuggee came from an agent.

truncated.description: A list above was cut by the budget (frames, locals, members or output).

timed_out.description: eludite.debug.wait, or a resuming command waiting with `wait_ms`: nothing settled in time (`mode` says what the debuggee is doing).

interrupted_by.description: The person took over while this agent's command waited (proposal 0001 rule 5): a resuming command of theirs (Continue, a step, Run To Cursor, Break All, Stop, Restart) ended the wait at once, and this summary is the state they caused. The agent's next resuming command is refused as stale until it reads the state again (eludite.debug.snapshot, state or wait) or quotes the current `stop`.

sessions.description: A compound start's answer (eludite.debug.start with `compound`) that timed out before any session broke: every session of the compound with its mode.

value.description: As the Locals window shows it; cut at `max_value_chars` with `… (N chars)` at the end. A null reference reads `null` on every adapter (eludite-dbg-mono's `(null)` is rewritten), as Visual Studio's C# Locals window shows it.

reference.description: Non-zero when the value has members: pass it to eludite.debug.variables (`reference`) with this stop.

evaluate_name.description: An expression that evaluates to this value; absent when it is `name` itself (most locals and parameters).

indexed.description: How many indexed members (elements) it has, when the adapter says.

named.description: How many named members (fields, properties) it has, when the adapter says.

children.description: With `depth` above 1: the members, each a row of this shape.

truncated.description: Not every member is listed in `children` (the row budget ran out); read them with `reference`.

capabilities.description: What the session's debug adapter supports, so a caller does not try what it lacks. Booleans unless noted; `adapter` or `shell` where the shell provides what the adapter lacks.

pause.description: Debug > Break All (eludite.debug.pause); every adapter has it.

set_variable.description: Values can be changed (eludite.debug.set_variable: DAP setVariable, or setExpression when the adapter has only that).

function_breakpoints.description: Breakpoints on a function by name (DAP setFunctionBreakpoints); eludite.debug.toggle_breakpoint with `function` is refused where false.

log_points.description: Tracepoints: `adapter` (DAP logMessage) or `shell` (the debugger emulates them with a stop, the message's evaluation and a resume per hit).

hit_conditions.description: Hit counts on breakpoints: `adapter` or `shell` (the debugger counts hits itself).

exception_filter_options.description: Exception settings can name exception types (DAP exceptionFilterOptions); eludite.debug.exception_settings with `types` is refused where false.

set_next_statement.description: Set Next Statement (eludite.debug.set_next_statement: DAP gotoTargets and goto); refused where false.

data_breakpoints.description: Break when a value changes (DAP data breakpoints).

restart.description: The adapter restarts a session itself (DAP restart).

terminate.description: The debuggee can be asked to end gracefully (DAP terminate).

modules.description: Loaded modules can be listed (DAP modules).

delayed_stack_loading.description: The adapter pages call stacks itself (DAP supportsDelayedStackTraceLoading); otherwise the debugger reads the stack once and pages it.

variable_paging.description: The adapter pages variables by `start` and `count`; otherwise the debugger reads them all and pages.
